annotations.title: Delete capital calls nobody has paid

description: Use this when the user wants a capital call in one of their funds removed from the record, not kept as cancelled, and nobody has paid it. Starts the deletion. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed deletion, saying which investors were already sent the notice and are not told, for the user to confirm. This call deletes nothing, and Capital Company never moves money.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York
